name: local-coding-agent-task-success-sandbox-v1
notes: Frozen four-task sandbox for measuring end-state task success of a local coding model driven by an agent harness. The sandbox is a tiny synthetic Python package: it is a controlled fixture, not a snapshot of any real project. Freeze it by hashing the tree (harness.tree_sha256) and never edit it in place. Tasks run sequentially in one working copy, so an early failure is inherited by later tasks; suite_modules scopes each task's suite so the frozen baseline failure in tests/test_report.py cannot mask an unrelated task.

tasks.prompt: Add a count() method to inventory.Store that returns the number of items currently held. Keep the existing tests green.
Add a new test module tests/test_count.py that asserts Store.count() reflects added and removed items. The scoped suite must pass.
tests/test_report.py fails on the frozen sandbox. Fix the production code in inventory/report.py so the whole suite passes. Do not edit the test.
Rename Store.add to Store.insert and update every caller and test in the sandbox. No 'add' definition or '.add(' call site may remain in any .py file, and the scoped suite must pass.
